geometry_edits: Rebuilt the single expected object from the official 11-vertex FID 752 GIS footprint in campus coordinates.
Replaced the generic 16 m block with two main brick stories and three intersecting front-facing gables based on the official exterior photo.
Added a raised entry tower, arched upper glazing and door surround, repeated mullioned windows, white trim, and dark shingle planes.
Retained identity transform; building footprint and placement remain campus-coordinate controlled.
uncertainties: GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 conflicts with the multi-level official photo; the field definition is unknown.
GIS Extrution=36 has no documented unit or meaning and was not treated as measured height.
The 2023 official image is not georeferenced; the chosen frontage orientation is illustrative.
Exact heights, levels, full wing arrangement, and roof intersections remain estimates.
